sections_layout.title: 1. Hero Physics Sandbox
sections_layout.details: Headline 'INTENT CREATES IMPACT.' and 'MOHD KAIF / MR SID' rendered as individual rigid body letters falling to an invisible floor. User's cursor is a custom Penrose-triangle rigid body that collides with and smashes letters around with real-time velocity.

sections_layout.title: 2. Manifesto & About Split Layout
sections_layout.details: Left side: Quote 'The life you live tomorrow is quietly being negotiated by the choices you make today.' assembles from floating kinetic particles on scroll. Right side: Interactive bio with GSAP mask reveal and hover liquid distortion.

sections_layout.title: 3. Infinite Vault Carousel
sections_layout.details: 8 project cards in an infinite horizontal loop. Dragging triggers RGB chromatic aberration and liquid wave shader distortions proportional to drag velocity. Click triggers GSAP Flip animation expanding card to detailed modal.

sections_layout.title: 4. Process Engine
sections_layout.details: Interactive blobs for Discovery, Development, and Deployment. Dragging Discovery into Development merges them into a gooey single body with rubber-band spring physics to unlock process breakdown.

sections_layout.title: 5. Client Voices (Physics Card Stack)
sections_layout.details: 5 physical cards stacked on top of each other. Users can swipe/throw the top card off screen with velocity to reveal the next testimonial card.

sections_layout.title: 6. Footer Black Hole & Contact
sections_layout.details: Large interactive contact banner 'HELLO@MOHDKAIF.COM'. Moving mouse turns cursor into a gravitational attractor pulling orbiting tech tags (WordPress, Elementor, GSAP, AI, WebGL). Hovering email magnetically snaps link to cursor and enables 1-click clipboard copy with toast feedback.

performance_and_accessibility.mobile_optimization: Automatically disable intense Matter.js body calculations or lower particle count on touch devices (< 768px). Provide smooth fallback touch drag.
performance_and_accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system accessibility settings by turning physics falling to static position grid when requested.
performance_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, project cards, theme toggle, copy email, drag handles) MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app leveraging Tailwind, GSAP, Lenis, Framer Motion / Matter.js / R3F.
Ensure dark/light mode toggle functions smoothly without layout reflows.
Include sound effects toggle option (subtle click/whoosh SFX optional/synthesized with Web Audio API for ultra tactile feedback).
All elements must react gracefully and provide immediate visual feedback on drag/click.
Include header floating navbar with theme toggle, sound toggle, menu links, and Mr Sid branding emblem.
